adjudication.rationale: In admin-group controller actions, `removeMember` calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member);` inside the bootbox callback and `addMembers` calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` without returning/handling the promise. In the model, both `removeMember` and `addMembers` return a `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` chain that only runs `findMembers()` on success; if the server responds with an error (e.g. 422 from `Admin::GroupsController#add_members/#remove_member` when `group.automatic`), the rejection is unhandled and no UI feedback is shown and the list won’t refresh. The diff shows no error handling pathway for these failures.
